coverage.acceptance: PROJECT-SCALE.yaml records lite / standard / full scale options, selected scale, gate_profile_bias, review_cadence_bias, scale reason, and explicit not_authorized boundaries.
PROJECT-SCALE.yaml bias is a recommendation only and does not directly modify process/policies/GATE-PROFILES.json.
ROADMAP.yaml and MILESTONES.yaml are project-level baseline objects with stable IDs, status enums, source refs, and cross-reference validation.
PROJECT.current.json remains refs-only and links scale_ref, roadmap_ref, and milestones_ref without embedding roadmap or milestone details.
meta-flow project check validates PROJECT.current.json, PROJECT-SCALE.yaml, ROADMAP.yaml, and MILESTONES.yaml together.
Tests cover legal scale, unsafe authorization semantics, invalid gate profile bias, roadmap/milestone schema errors, duplicate IDs, broken refs, cross-ref mismatch, and typed snapshot loading.
No direct write is made to process/policies/GATE-PROFILES.json and no process/quant-lab or docs path is modified.

risks.mitigation: S06 extends the existing project module and project check path rather than creating a parallel gate policy or ledger mechanism.
Process artifacts were generated by host-orchestrator inline-fallback after user approval; future S07+ process evidence should be host-owned.
S06 YAML parsing is scoped to controlled project baseline files; future richer YAML should use a shared parser or JSON-compatible format.
